\subsection{Physical Uniqueness Theorem}
\begin{theorem}[Physical Uniqueness of the W33 Heptad Family -- BT1354]
The W33 heptad circulant CSS family is the unique member of the circulant CSS class satisfying:
(1) spectral gates Q4, Q5, Q6;
(2) optical budget: loss $\leq0.12$\,dB/hop, isolation $\geq35$\,dB, single-photon only.
Witness chain: \texttt{bt1338}--\texttt{bt1354}.
\end{theorem}
